description:
Required parameters: principal, rate and tenure. Optional: tenureUnit
  (years|months, default years) and startMonth (YYYY-MM). Expected EMIs and
  schedules come from the suite's own amortisation code, not the app's.

the yearly schedule should match my own amortisation

name: LoanLens API - EMI calculator (GET /api/emi)

description:
Filtering, search, sorting and pagination over the mock loan book. Every
  successful response is checked against an independent oracle that reads the
  mock database file and applies the documented query rules itself.

elements.name: Defaults (page 1, newest) returns exactly the matching loans

the response should match the "loan list" schema
the response should contain exactly the loans the loan book has for that query

description:
The API is read-only, speaks JSON on every path (including errors), and
  rejects methods and routes it does not serve with a structured error body.

elements.name: Health check reports the service is up

steps.name: I send a GET request to "/health"
the response should match the "health" schema
the response should not carry the header "X-Powered-By"

elements.name: The filter vocabulary lists every loan type, status and city in the loan book

steps.name: I send a GET request to "/meta"
the response should match the "meta" schema
the vocabulary should list exactly the loan types, statuses and cities of the loan book

elements.name: An unknown route returns a JSON 404, not an HTML page

steps.name: I send a GET request to "/does-not-exist"
the response should match the "error" schema

elements.name: A write method is refused with 405 and an Allow header

steps.name: I send a POST request to "/loans"
the response header "Allow" should be "GET, HEAD"
the response should match the "error" schema

elements.name: An error that repeats the caller's input is served as JSON the browser may not reinterpret

steps.name: I send a GET request to "/loans/LN-1%3Cscript%3E"

elements.name: A page on another site is not given read access to the API

steps.name: I send a GET request to "/loans" from a page on "https://attacker.example"
the response should not carry the header "Access-Control-Allow-Origin"

elements.name: A URL with broken percent-encoding is a client error, not a server failure

steps.name: I send a GET request to "/loans/%E0%A4%A"
the response should match the "error" schema

elements.name: A request with 50 query parameters, the most allowed, is accepted

steps.name: I send a GET request to "/loans/summary" with "type=home" repeated 50 times

elements.name: A request with 51 query parameters is refused

steps.name: I send a GET request to "/loans/summary" with "type=home" repeated 51 times
the response should match the "error" schema

name: LoanLens API - service basics

description:
The dashboard figures. Totals, the weighted average rate and the monthly EMI
  inflow are recomputed independently from the loan book.

steps.name: I send a GET request to "/loans/summary"
the response should match the "loan summary" schema

the status breakdown should add up to the totals

the status breakdown should add up to the totals

the status breakdown should add up to the totals
